analysis_corrections.why: v0.1.0 paired each toggle with the first icon change after its dispatch. When the dispatch->icon latency is comparable to the toggle spacing, that hands a toggle its PREDECESSOR's change (in the 2026-09-22 real run toggles 1 and 2 were both assigned the +20.6 s change). Replaced by a FIFO chain over toggle -> wire request -> wire response -> icon change, valid only when all four counts agree and the icon alternates (see fifo_valid).
